text: |Gal(E/F)| = [E:F] holds for every finite extension E/F.
explanation: Equality characterizes Galois (normal + separable) extensions. For ℚ(∛2)/ℚ of degree 3, an automorphism must send ∛2 to a root of x³−2 lying in the field, and the other two roots are non-real, so the automorphism group is trivial.
